subject.title: feat(review): opt-in external CLI engine for offline local review

question: Should ClawSweeper core accept this opt-in local `--engine external` subprocess surface despite the current Codex-specific direction?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and the previous correctness findings appear fixed, but it changes the product and security boundary for review tooling; automation cannot decide whether this external subprocess surface belongs in core.

options.title: Keep Core Codex-Only
options.body: Pause or close this PR unless a maintainer explicitly wants a local-only exception to the current Codex-specific direction.

options.title: Accept Local-Only External Engines
options.body: Merge only with maintainer signoff while preserving the restriction to offline local review paths and excluding hosted review, apply, repair, and automerge.

options.title: Ask For A Narrower Surface
options.body: Require a smaller docs, recipe, or future extension path instead of adding a core `--engine external` mode now.

recommendation.title: Keep Core Codex-Only
recommendation.body: Pause or close this PR unless a maintainer explicitly wants a local-only exception to the current Codex-specific direction.
